newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline prices ease.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline prices ease.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline prices eased on steady differentials late Thursday, tracking a drop in front-month contract prices, traders said.

Differentials were largely unchanged as the spot market focused on movement in the NYMEX complex and buyers retreated to the sidelines waiting out the recent turbulence in front-month futures, traders said.
"There's always a lull in the spot market when the Merc is going crazy like this," one Chicago trader said.

Prompt unleaded gasoline differentials were steady at bids 1.0 cent over the print in Chicago and Group Three. Later deliveries were bid 1.25 cent under the print in Chicago and 0.50 cent under in Group Three.
Low sulphur diesel for prompt and later September deliveries was talked 1.75/2.0 cents over the print in Chicago, where high sulphur remained 0.25 cent over the print.

Group Three low sulphur diesel remained 3.75/4.0 cents over the print for prompt deliveries and 2.75/3.0 cents over for later deliveries. High sulphur was steady at 1.75 cents over the print, traders said.
